name: HC37d : Tested for CRAG
description:
Number of active non-suppressed ART clients with CD4 below 200 who received a CRAG test during the reporting period.
CRAG testing may come from the non-suppressed follow-up form or the confirmed laboratory names CRAG TEST, CRAG TEST RESULTS, or CRYPTOCOCCAL ANTIGEN TEST.

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT n.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_non_suppressed_card n
WHERE n.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  AND n.cd4_count < 200
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_test_orders_results r
      WHERE r.patient_id = n.patient_id
        AND r.test_concept_id = 165290
        AND r.encounter_datetime BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
        AND (
            UPPER(TRIM(r.test_value)) = 'POSITIVE'
            OR UPPER(TRIM(r.test_value)) = 'NEGATIVE'
        )
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v
      WHERE v.patient_id = n.patient_id
        AND v.is_valid_result = 1
        AND v.is_unsuppressed = 1
        AND COALESCE(
            v.sample_collection_date,
            v.viral_load_clinical_date,
            v.laboratory_result_date,
            v.order_date
        ) <= n.encounter_date
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = n.patient_id
        AND (
            a.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
